generated_from.pain_hypothesis: As Ares expands its credit practice and deploys billions in new debt capital, investment teams face increased pressure to efficiently analyze legal documents, covenants, and credit market news across large volumes of deals.

emails.subject: asset-based finance expansion at Ares
emails.body:
With Ares deploying $12.7 billion in asset-based finance, your investment teams are likely scaling deal execution and portfolio oversight.

When managing debt documentation, legal covenants, and credit market news at this volume, what usually breaks first in your review workflow?

We build Octus to help credit teams streamline covenant tracking and deal document review.

Best,
agneshmp07@gmail.com

emails.subject: credit practice workflows at Ares
emails.body:
When credit practices scale rapidly, tracking debt covenants and parsing complex legal documents across private credit deals usually gets fragmented across spreadsheets and manual feeds.

Does that match what you are seeing as Ares recruits for open roles across its credit practice, or do you already have a smooth workflow for document review?

At Octus, we are building a credit market intelligence and document management platform specifically for sub-investment grade debt.

Best,
agneshmp07@gmail.com

emails.trigger_link: As Ares hires new credit professionals, standardizing legal document review and covenant tracking across expanding deal teams becomes challenging.

emails.subject: Asia credit deal analysis
emails.body:
Following E.G. Morse taking on leadership of Asia credit at Ares, your regional credit operations are likely scaling deal evaluation.

If we brought you automated covenant analysis and credit document tools tailored for debt deals in your market, would you be willing to look at it? A yes commits you to nothing—we are early stage at Octus and looking for direct feedback from credit leaders.

Best,
agneshmp07@gmail.com
